profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Large-Scale Systems | High-Volume Platforms | Automation & Integrations
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer specializing in scalable platform development, serverless architecture, and intelligent automation. Demonstrated success modernizing complex systems into efficient, high-performance solutions that improve operations and support revenue growth. Built AI-powered automation for business-critical processes, developed real-time data infrastructure at scale, and led architectural transformations to modern technology stacks. Trusted partner to leadership teams, consistently delivering performant, maintainable solutions that balance current needs with future scalability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Boca Raton, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Architected business process automation using LLM models: designed and shipped multi-agent AI systems (OpenAI GPT-4o + n8n + LangChain) for HR, Finance, and Compliance, automating onboarding, payroll reconciliation, and audit reporting reducing manual processing time by 70% and saving 1,200+ labor hours per quarter.
- Led strategic integrations: partnered with Sales and Operations to integrate key third-party platforms, enabling real-time data sync and eliminating manual data entry across CRM, inventory, and financial systems.
- Designed serverless automation pipelines: built n8n and AWS Lambda workflows for cross-departmental processes, improving data accuracy by 85% and cutting cycle times from days to minutes.
- Drove technical leadership: translated executive business requirements into AI-driven technical roadmaps, mentored junior engineers via code reviews and pair programming, and established team-wide code quality standards.

positions.title: Lead Full-Stack Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernized platform architecture: led migration from legacy Ruby on Rails + PostgreSQL monolith to a serverless Next.js + Node.js microservices stack on AWS, reducing infrastructure costs by 40% and improving page load times by 60%.
- Engineered compliance systems: built advanced payroll and compliance reporting engine handling 10K+ employee records with 99.9% accuracy, reducing audit prep time from weeks to hours.
- Scaled data infrastructure: designed hybrid PostgreSQL + DynamoDB data layer supporting real-time analytics, powering executive dashboards processing millions of transactions daily.
- Established DevOps practices: implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and AWS, reducing deployment time from hours to minutes and increasing release frequency by 300%.
- Introduced intelligent automation: integrated LLM-powered document parsing and classification into compliance workflows, reducing manual review time by 65% and improving data extraction accuracy across unstructured payroll documents.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built high-performance mobile platform: developed React + Ionic 4 PWA serving 50K+ users, implementing offline-first architecture and achieving 95+ Lighthouse performance scores.
- Implemented enterprise search: integrated Elasticsearch across 1M+ records, reducing average query time from 8s to sub-200ms (40× improvement).
- Created real-time analytics: built AWS-powered reporting dashboard with live data visualization, enabling operations teams to monitor KPIs and respond to incidents in real time.
- Optimized data layer: designed PostgreSQL + DynamoDB schema supporting reporting workloads at scale.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: At Overseas Travel International, I played a pivotal role as a Senior Full Stack Web Developer, focusing on enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. I developed a modular React component library to ensure UI scalability across diverse travel platforms. Additionally, I improved CI/CD pipelines, which led to faster deployments and increased reliability in releases. My efforts in optimizing React performance for real-time data consumption significantly enhanced customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer / Software Programmer
positions.description: At Reagan Wireless Corp., I played a pivotal role in enhancing the Digital Inventory Handler platform, ensuring improved accuracy in inventory management. I designed and deployed RESTful APIs that seamlessly integrated internal tools with iOS mobile applications, facilitating better data access for sales and operations teams. My contributions significantly supported business operations and streamlined processes.
